intro: Football is the most popular sport in the Comoros, which has surprised bigger nations.

chapters.title: Football
text: The Coelacanths reached the Africa Cup of Nations for the first time in 2022 and beat Ghana to reach the knockouts.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Beach football and running are popular.

places.title: Famous venues
places.intro: Where the Comoros' biggest sporting moments happen.
